key_insight: Surface coating technologies can substantially extend agricultural machinery life by mitigating wear, corrosion, and fatigue across diverse operating conditions.
engineering_relevance: The review helps engineers choose between laser cladding, thermal spraying, and physical vapor deposition based on component failure mode, durability needs, and field applicability.
method: Classifies agricultural components by failure mode and service environment
Compares laser cladding, thermal spraying, and PVD for wear resistance and practical deployment
Explains strengthening mechanisms from microstructure, wear, and corrosion perspectives
evidence_signal: The paper is a review and comparative analysis of coating strategies, technologies, and strengthening mechanisms rather than a new experimental dataset.
watch_item: Field performance may differ from lab-based coating behavior, so process selection must account for service complexity, adhesion, cost, and repairability.
paper_title: Research Advances of Surface Strengthening Coatings for Agricultural Machinery and Equipment
